name: listLast
description: Gets the last element of a list.
syntax: listLast( string list, [string delimiters], [boolean includeEmptyFields], [number count] )

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if set to true, empty values are included as well

params.name: count
params.description: specifies how many items to return from the end of the list. default is 1.
